name: ../hanged/clips/attack_r2
prompt: One single attack to the right: the dead man lurches forward to the right and grabs once with both bare clawed hands, then staggers back into the same stance. Slow motion, one single even movement. One strike only. HANDS CANON: no weapon, bare clawed hands; nothing is ever held in the hands. The figure keeps exactly the same body, the same face and the same limbs for the whole clip. The noose rope stays around the neck. No weapon of any kind appears, no knife, no blade, only its own bare clawed hands. No visual effects, no flashes, no trails, no glow, no particles.
